episodes.title: Peace in the Valley
episodes.summary: When a pharmacy heist becomes a murder investigation, Eden Vale Police Chief, Big Hank, coaxes estranged son, Henry, home to partner with his detective big sister, Lou, despite their wildly different personalities and policing methods.

episodes.title: The King's Assassin
episodes.summary: While the rest of the force is focused on Big Hank's annual charity fundraiser, Lou and Henry must investigate the suspicious death of a visiting crypto bro who eats a poisonous mushroom.

episodes.title: Mr. Popular
episodes.summary: When the Eden Vale High star quarterback is attacked, disturbing secrets are uncovered that reveal just what extremes people will go to in order to win.

episodes.title: Found Footage
episodes.summary: When Lily goes into the woods with her friends to make a low budget horror movie, she gets more than she bargained for after their leading lady of questionable talent goes missing.

episodes.title: Family Trees
episodes.summary: When Lou and Henry go undercover for a case involving a high-stakes I.P. theft, Lou is forced to confront a painful truth about her past.

episodes.title: Explosions
episodes.summary: An explosive family secret sends shockwaves through the Hickmans, but they must put their tensions aside when Eden Vale becomes the target of a sabotage attack.

episodes.title: Buckle Up
episodes.summary: As Lou and Henry discover the accidental death of a rodeo champion was in fact murder, Hank's choice of Best Man ruffles feathers, and Sam and Sarika find themselves on the verge of busting the skeleton case wide open.

episodes.title: Skeletons
episodes.summary: Shocking revelations threaten to tear Eden Vale apart as the killer from a decades old murder is revealed.
